source_cut_relations: Console d_st1 console read is reached only by a previous non-reset d_st0 read accept, which leaves hold unchanged.
PicoRV32 with resetn low at that preceding clock clears mem_valid; this is actual unchanged vendor CPU behavior, not an arbitrary master assumption.
Deferred write implies !cpu_rst and req&&sel_per; actual per_ready becomes1, so next req is0 regardless of new mem_valid/address.
Current d_st1 advances to3, so next demanded read is false; rst only further disables the read.
TX rf_wr pulse is created by B_IDLE and consumed in B_RF; demand read requires B_IDLE.
limitations: Source cut relations were checked by anchored syntax and manual reachable-state argument; not a complete automated whole-RTL induction.
Bus ACK/data/committed-word miters have not run.
Physical CEA/CEB/INIT/mode and original52 timing constraints require the one combined actual SYN/PNR review.

TXshadow_v1_limit: Static review found RO-Q writes also receive B_RF data. Version1 used !bus_we and could leave that returned data stale; no simulator ran. Version2 refreshes on every accepted Q-address transaction, including writes, and adds the RO-write miter case.
